notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.0.7
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Today we're all on fixing issues, saving your ears from being blasted and providing more functionality for our speedrunning community, especially if you play with controller!

The following changes have been made:


Fixed Steam achievements not triggering (un-triggered Steam achievements will be awarded on game restart)
Intro and Outro sound is now affected by sound settings
Quick reset (speedrunning settings) now works and properly awards new-run specific achievements
Quick reset now also works on gamepad (default: select)
Added unstuck button that teleports to the start of the area if all else fails



Stay tuned for more updates!

Keep tilting friends
Gustav

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.0.1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Today we're uploading a small patch, fixing and improving minor things in the game.
Following changes have been made:


Game now saves when quitting with Alt+F4
Game now automatically pauses when minimizing the game
Fixed a bug where Steam Achievements wouldn't trigger
Achievements that were awarded in-game but not on Steam will now trigger on game start
Fixed gameplay settings not saving
Fixed a bug where the game would un-pause when opening Steam overlay while in pause menu


We'll be on more fixes and improvements in the following days.

Cheers
Gustav

notes.title: Next Fest Game Update - NF.1
notes.notes:
Hello Rage-Froggers!

We've updated the Demo as we've noticed some issues!
We've changed some minor things in the settings, but also larger parts like the Level Design!

The changes we made:
- Level 1.1 Cave entry: The Entry is now different and easier to enter. The jump after remains difficult.
- The achievements should now properly be picked up by Steam
- The Menu opens properly in Main Menu
- The Menu UI is fixed and correctly displayed

Thanks for playing and helping us make the game great!

Oh and most importantly: Happy tilting!

Cheers
Julien

notes.title: NEW CONTENT UPDATE: Level of the Month - July!
notes.notes:
Hey hey froggy peeps!

Happy to announce that there's a new level of the month! This time the level is a bit on the easier side but has a fun little secret that may surprise you! Also we designed a new background and changed the parallax System!

As with all our updates, we've taken your feedback into account to fine-tune and improve the gameplay experience, ensuring it remains challenging yet fair. Hope you like it and more than happy to receive more feedback that will go directly into improving tilt frog as a whole!

If you've got thoughts or suggestions, don't hesitate to drop them in the official feedback thread on our Discord Server. Your input is invaluable in helping us make Tilt Frog the best it can be.

ENJOY and have a good one!

All the best,
Julien

notes.title: Demo Update: Level of the Month (April) now live!
notes.notes:
New Content

Hey everybody, we're happy to announce THE tilt frog DEMO coming with a major update here on Steam!
This time we're bringing a free content update for tilt frog

From now on we will put out a new free "Level of the Month" each month that you can play for the limited time period during that month only, so don't miss out before they're gone!

Feel free to share any feedback or bugs you might encounter in the Official Discord thread for the level of the month on our Discord-Server. Also don't forget to post your best times beating the new level so you too can be part of the speedrunning leaderboard!

(If you haven't beaten the main demo yet we'd recommend doing so first before you play new content as the level for this month is definitely harder than the beginning of the main demo. If you'd like to suffer though go ahead, I won't stop you.)


As always have fun and happy tilting!
~ Gustav


Summary

Major Changes


Added "Level of the Month" for April, now playable directly from the menu (you can either choose the main demo or level of the month when hitting play)


Other Changes & Fixes


Testing new sprites for the mushroom biome in the main demo
Controls now automatically switch back to keyboard & mouse when you move the mouse (before you needed to click in order to change back which would sometimes throw people off)
Fixed the controller aim line jittering when jumping with the frog
Fixed the mouse cursor still being shown in main menu and loading screen even when controller was being used
